trial_court: Judge, Family Court, Belagavi, Matrimonial Case No.438/2015
case_name: Smt. Vinuta W/O Nitin Sambrekar vs Nitin S/O Satish Sambrekar
facts_of_case: The parties are seeking dissolution of their marriage solemnized on 12/12/2013 by mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the marriage has broken down irretrievably.
legal_principles.held: Efforts to solve the differences between the parties were made by elders and families from both the sides, but all efforts for reconciliation failed and the parties continued to live separately.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking divorce by mutual consent must demonstrate that the marriage has irretrievably broken down.
legal_principles.held: During April 2015 both the parties along with their elders and well-wishers decided to mutually end the marriage and talks were also held to chalk out the separation plan, but the same could not materialize and the appellant and respondent started living separately from 19/11/2015.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the petition for dissolution of marriage is granted.
